| Code | Condition | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 101 | Power module voltage is below the safe operating threshold after the controller self-test has completed. | Recharge the module, repeat the complete self-test, and replace it if the condition remains active. |
| 102 | Power module temperature is above the safe charging threshold after an extended operating cycle. | Disconnect the charger, allow the module to cool, and inspect the cooling path before retrying. |
| 190 | Communication with the controller was interrupted during the full startup sequence. | Inspect the connector and cable, reseat both ends, and repeat startup before replacing either component. |
| 101 | Power module voltage is below the safe operating threshold; this duplicate summary is printed in the quick-reference row. | Follow the detailed code 101 procedure and record the final measured voltage in the maintenance log. |
| 102 | Power module temperature remains high while external power is connected to the unit. | Verify ambient temperature and charger output before returning the unit to service. |
| 190 | Controller communication was restored but the startup history still contains the earlier interruption. | Clear the history only after confirming a complete successful startup and preserving the service record. |
